svg.title: 10-year cost to own a 50-gallon water heater, by state
svg.desc: Dot plot of installed price plus 10 years of energy for a gas tank, heat pump and electric tank in each state and DC, ranked from cheapest to own (Idaho) to most expensive (Massachusetts). The full numbers are in the table below the chart.
svg.text: 10-year cost to own a 50-gallon water heater, by state
Installed price + 10 years of energy for a typical household. Ranked by the cheapest of the three.
